releases.name: OpenCode Goal v0.4.2
releases.body:
### Changed

- Updated installation, configuration, runtime, and local development guidance for OpenCode 2.
- Aligned package entrypoint and repository metadata with the OpenCode 2 plugin.
Fix OpenCode 2 TUI keymap registration so the plugin loads without the Keymap.Provider error.

## Removed

- Removed run limits from goal state, commands, tools, prompts, and the TUI.

OpenCode 2 beta compatibility through the dual-runtime server entrypoint, V2 model tools, event-backed transcript accounting, session context injection, and the V2 TUI sidebar and /goal keymap command. See CHANGELOG.md for details.

releases.name: OpenCode Goal v0.2.0
releases.body:
## Highlights

- Add a native OpenCode TUI sidebar entrypoint with per-session goal status, objective, elapsed time, usage, evaluator reason, and budget progress.
- Add the agent-callable `create_goal` tool with optional budgets and unfinished-goal protection.
- Stabilize the evaluator-failure test across the Node.js 20, 22, and 24 CI matrix.

Install with `npm install @beremaran/opencode-goal@0.2.0`.
